abilities.name: Ground Armor
abilities.text: Use before a Friendly Ground Unit makes an Armour Roll. That Unit gains TOUGH (1) for this roll.

abilities.name: Ground Weapons
abilities.text: The active Ground Unit's first Ranged Weapon used gains CRITICAL HIT (1).
